verdict.rationale: Obsidian ships a core Templates plugin for inserting pre-defined snippets (with variables like {{date}}, {{title}}) into notes, and a Daily notes core plugin that creates date-based recurring notes automatically, directly matching the story's need for reusable templates with variables applied to recurring note types. Community evidence corroborates real-world use of Obsidian's note structures for recurring workflows (e.g., daily dev notes, RPG session notes). Missing for 10: no explicit documentation snippet showing the exact variable syntax (e.g., {{date}}, {{title}}) or independent hands-on confirmation of template variable behavior beyond the docs summary.
